_about: The models the Evals workflow compares (tools/evals.py): each one's name in the report, and its file on Hugging Face. A .litertlm file runs on the app's engine; a .gguf file on llama.cpp, for a model with no .litertlm version (the app can't run it yet).

models.name: Tiny Aya Global
models.note: Cohere's 3.35B text-only model for 70 languages (CC BY-NC 4.0). Only published as GGUF, so it runs on llama.cpp here; the app would need it converted to .litertlm, or a second engine.
